blocks.text: The countdown to Motunui begins. As Disney’s Moana Live-to-Film Concert sails towards its October 3–4 performances at The Theatre at Solaire, anticipation is building for a weekend of music, adventure, and a special opportunity for fans to meet the artists bringing the beloved story to life. The concert will feature Disney’s Moana projected on the big screen, with its acclaimed score and songs performed live by the 78-member Filharmonika Orchestra.
